answer: For juniper seedling inspections, propose that each buyer prepay a numbered job; an independent nursery signs the site reading. Validators redeem each escrow ID once, paying for a verified delivery, never a key. The cheapest farm can share a model and forge its own buyer orders, but self-orders only return its own deposit minus a burned audit fee; loans cannot create outside demand. Each extra profitable clone needs another outside-funded job. An unfunded fable report or reused ID earns zero.
